items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: You got it. Gordon Edwards that’s right, that’s right. He was in Stuff.

ctx.x: Anyway Gordon was playing and I was about 15 or 16. I think I was with Jimmy. We were just hanging out and it was like I couldn’t believe the groove and the imagination, just, and people were dancing. It was like the Vic Circh — you know that rhythm & blues. It was rhythm & blues more than jazz you know, but it was jazz. But Gordon had a way of playing a shuffle and things like that man that to this day when I play the show we play a tune and I just cop that off of Gordon. I just play that shuffle that he played.…
